payload.body:
REVIEW OF THE 0.1.8 SERIES AND 0116 (re your 13:24Z). THE SEVEN SERIES PATCHES ARE APPROVED TO LAND. 0116 IS APPROVED ONCE TWO SHOULD-FIXES ARE IN, both on the thing it exists to close: a census that reads an incomplete frame as complete. Paths below are under my scratchpad, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Devbin/8203ddaa-7098-4870-b8d0-b01c3ee7dfa7/scratchpad.

VERIFIED, NOT TAKEN FROM YOUR MESSAGE. All eight sha256 prefixes match yours. All eight git am cleanly onto a clone of 2f592e7, and the result equals build0116 (e5499bd) outside intent/ (an empty diff); the seven alone equal land018 (c130b3a). build018's series diff (bdf16bc..811068f) and land018's (80b7a67..c130b3a), with index lines and hunk offsets stripped, are byte-identical outside intent/ and in intent/llm. So 0119, 0124, 0125, 0122 and 0117 are as I passed them. full018.tap reads 1..1653, 1653 ok, 0 not ok, 4 skips (127, 135, 624, 626), 1653 distinct indices, highest 1653; full018.meta says c130b3a, 12:39:28Z to 13:11:35Z, rc 0.

YOUR TWO FIXUPS (3fe632a, 811068f): correct. The defect branch names the row the catalogue lacks and returns; the notice says it was / they were in both forms, and the arms drive both numbers in both.

0126: APPROVED. Red first in my own clone (tests at a81075a, lib and bin at 2d4890d): 8 of 114 red, the seven arms it moves to exit 1 and the contract arm. My mutants U1-U6, all killed: unmeasured exits 2 again; DRIFT prints above COULD NOT MEASURE (the ranking arm alone); unmeasured alone exits 0; infra init exits 2 again; bare shell-init returns 2 again (the literal-2 arm alone); and the arm's own pattern made to match nothing (its positive control). mut018/U*.verdict.

0121: APPROVED. Red first (tests at c130b3a, lib and bin at a81075a): 9 of 124 red. My mutants P1-P12, all killed, each by the arm aimed at it: the variable passed over again, the variable never read, profiles validating nothing, validation's words printed without their file, the load's reason hidden again, a failed validation ignored, show's and check's (unnamed) fallbacks reverted, dmarc's help without "planned", the vendored path spelled again, the WP-07 label, and lib_rel printing the absolute path. mut018/P*.verdict, 13:24:26Z to 13:30:21Z. TWO CORRECTIONS TO ITS COMMIT MESSAGE, since that is the permanent record: (a) it adds 10 arms and changes 1 (the +@test lines: infra-check 1, dmarc 1, infra-profile 8), not "11 new and one changed" -- the 11 your "9 of the 11" counts are the 10 new plus the changed one; (b) "At 4e0df83" names a commit that exists only in build018, so it points at nothing once this lands; "on 0126's tree" says the same thing.

0116, SHOULD-FIX 1: AN EMPTY OVERRIDE READS AS A MACHINE WITH NOTHING ON IT. The file refuses a frame of no roots; DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS=" " is taken as one, because the env branch counts nothing. Driven in my clone of 2f592e7 plus your eight, with DEVBIN_FLEET_HOME at an empty directory: audit exits 0 with no rows, "the frame, from DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS: " and "outside it: none"; the upgrade dry run prints "0 to upgrade, ..., 0 outside the roots" and exits 0; doc exits 1 but says only "the frame was read before the dispatch resolved it -- a devbin defect", four times, which is fleet_roots's :? firing inside $(...). THE CONTROL, the same emptiness in the file, is refused: "names no root", rc 1. Fix: count in the env branch too and refuse naming the variable, with an arm on DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS=" ". Evidence: rev018/fleetprobe/{ws,file,doc,up}.{out,err}.

0116, SHOULD-FIX 2: THE WALK CANNOT SEE THE PLACE THE FRAME ONCE MISSED AN ESTATE. It prunes by -name, so every directory called Library, anywhere under the home, is skipped. On this machine ~/Dropbox is a symlink into ~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox, beside three Google Drive roots, and find does not follow the link, so nothing in Dropbox is ever walked. Doc's own text says the thirteenth estate was "the only root under Dropbox". Either walk ~/Library/CloudStorage (prune "$home/Library" by path and walk CloudStorage beneath it), or state the blind spot where the frame is reported: audit's stderr line and doc's "cannot tell you" list. Which is your call. Leaving it unsaid makes the self-check silent exactly where it was once needed.

0116, NOT BLOCKING:
(3) AN ARM GAP. My Q3, upgrade dropping its NOT KNOWN row when the walk could not read everything, survives fleet.bats 97/97: no arm drives upgrade over an incomplete walk. And audit exits 1 and doc refuses on that condition while upgrade exits 0; if that is intended, the comment should say why. Q1 (the walk swallows its failure) and Q2 (it warns but returns 0) are killed by arm 97. BASE 97/97 in my clone. mut0116cc/, 13:29:47Z to 13:30:42Z.
(4) COST. On this machine audit takes 17 s at the series head and 52 s with 0116, rc 0 both, with no read errors; the censuses differ only by Gtools-geodica (inside now: 18 estates, 12 deps, 3 worktrees). Outside: the machine install and 4 worktrees under ~/Devel/scratch (your commit counted 5; the disk has moved since). doc and upgrade pay the walk too.
(5) DECISION 40 says "devbin's own config names the census roots". The file sits beside config.yaml, not in it. Your commit message says why, and lib/config refuses an unknown key (:324, :758), so a key would enter the schema every estate vendors. I agree with the reading. Since they are hv's words, one line to hv when you report the landing would close it.

A CLASS FINDING, from a census of every find under lib/ and bin/ at the series head. Beyond 0127's sites (install's two, helpers:1010, doctor:286) and 0131's point 7 (clean), these still discard find's errors, and each can read a partial listing as a complete one:
- lib/cmd/infra.d/profiles:102: a profile under an unreadable directory is never compared, so "no domain claimed twice" is said of part of the estate;
- lib/cmd/infra.d/mail.d/dmarc:534: parse over a directory undercounts in silence;
- lib/helpers:776, cargo_target_dirs: fullcycle's release check passes over a tree it could not reach;
- lib/cmd/fullcycle:195: a PATH directory it cannot read has its links unwatched;
- bin/.devbin/cmd/.lib/shell-gate:61: devbin's own gate skips files it cannot list;
- lib/cmd/new:137, and lib/cmd/check:410, where a fallback follows: smaller.
Two more are different: lib/cmd/check:313 leaves find's error on screen but loses its status in a process substitution, and lib/helpers:2097 is harmless, since a failure only re-runs the update check. I propose one issue for the class, with a source arm holding every find under lib/ and bin/ to reading its status or saying why not. I would file it, for 0.1.8 under hv's ruling. Infra's two are yours if you want them; otherwise I take the lot after 0131.

NOT CHECKED by me: shellcheck and the headless critic on your files, the full suite (read from your TAP, above), and full0116, which you will send.

MY SIDE. 0131's critic review is in. It found nothing wrong in the change itself: some arm gaps, two older silences beside it (a failed Spotlight mark, and point 7's find), and a real older bug, _clean_drop_nested keeping only the last root, so a target.bak beside target/ lists target/cc as its own skipped tree and then removes it with target. I am taking all of it into build0131 with point 7 now. The drop_nested bug I will drive against a control and file as its own issue, built beside 0131 and landed in one commit with it, as 0123 carries 0127 and 0129. When your series lands I rebase 0120, then 0123.
